resources.string: Allow this phone to recover your existing Google passwords after you unlock it. First recover access with Google if your passwords are locked.
Set a secure screen lock before allowing this phone to recover passwords.
Allow this phone to recover the existing passwords for this account? This adds this phone as a recovery device. Keep your screen lock private.
The earlier request may still finish. We will check Google first, then create a new attempt for the same phone if it is still needed. The earlier request and phone key remain saved.

Stop showing this attempt as pending? Its history and phone key remain protected on this phone. Closing it does not cancel a request that Google may already have received or remove this phone from Google.
Google confirmed that this phone can recover these passwords.
The request is saved on this phone and has not been confirmed by Google.
Google may have received the request. Refresh to check its result before deciding whether to try again.
Google refused this request. You can refresh or review a new attempt.
Google no longer lists this phone as a recovery device for these passwords.
We could not confirm this phone. Check your connection and recover access with Google if needed. Any saved request remains available when you refresh.
Your Google password settings changed. Reopen password management and review the account again.
